newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli soldiers shoot Palestinian in Gaza - PLO.
newsitem.headline: Israeli soldiers shoot Palestinian in Gaza - PLO.

text.p: Israeli soldiers shot and wounded a Palestinian in the southern Gaza Strip on Monday, a Palestinian officer said.

"Ayman Qishteh, 29, was driving his cart to the seashore but the Israelis shot him twice in the back," Khaled Abu al-Lila, head of the Palestinian liaison office with the Israeli army in the area, told Reuters. An Israeli military spokeswoman said she was checking the report.
The wounded Palestinian was taken to hospital. Lila said he sustained "moderate wounds".
Israeli forces have been on alert for suicide attacks by Moslem militants since a bombing in a Tel Aviv cafe on Friday in which three Israeli women were killed.

"Instead of trying to catch him or even stop him, the soldiers shot at him," said Lila, a Palestinian police captain. "The atmosphere has been tense and we have been trying to calm things down. It is hard to understand why Israel insists on raising tension."

He said Palestinian authorities intended to make a formal protest to the Israeli side over the shooting near the Jewish settlement of Rafiah Yam. Earlier on Monday the army said a soldier had opened fire after two petrol bombs were thrown at an Israeli patrol in Rafah but the statement did not mention casualties.
